title: Essential Bengali Adjectives
summary: Describe size, quality, age, color, and condition.

phrases.en: This food is very good.
That house is very large.
My room is small but comfortable.
The river is deep and wide here.
This path is narrow and winding.
The garden looks very beautiful today.
Your table is clean and tidy.
The leaves became shiny after the rain.
The room is bright but simple.
Her hair is messy today.
I bought a new book.
This temple is very ancient.
The fruit is still fresh.
Do not use the broken cup.
The work is still incomplete.
The tea is hot, but the water is cold.

phrases.bn: এই কম্বলটি খুব নরম ও উষ্ণ।
phrases.pronunciation: ei kombolti khub norom o ushno
phrases.en: This blanket is very soft and warm.
The wet floor is very slippery.
The knife is sharp but heavy.
The ripe mango is soft and juicy.
This mango is very sweet.
The curry is spicy and well-seasoned.
The soup is delicious and nutritious.
The lemon is sour but juicy.
The stale food smells foul.
This question is very easy.

phrases.bn: শেষ সমস্যাটি বেশ কঠিন ও জটিল।
phrases.pronunciation: shesh shomoshyati besh kothin o jotil
phrases.en: The last problem is quite difficult and complex.
Your plan is simple but effective.
Her answer is correct and precise.
This chair is very comfortable.
Rima is very kind and caring.
My teacher is calm and patient.
The boy is intelligent but shy.
An honest person is trustworthy.
She is very hardworking and responsible.
I am very happy today.
She was anxious before the exam.

phrases.bn: দীর্ঘ ভ্রমণের পরে আমরা ক্লান্ত ছিলাম।
phrases.pronunciation: dirgho bhromoner pore amra klanto chhilam
phrases.en: We were tired after the long journey.
The child is hungry and thirsty.
The sick person is healthy now.
We have enough time.
Many books are available in this shop.
The bottle is completely empty now.
Our resources are limited.
This information is insufficient.
This shirt is inexpensive but good.
That phone is very expensive.
The old letter is valuable to me.
This advice is very useful.
Contaminated water is harmful to health.
Your answer is completely correct.
Is this news true or false?
Rain is possible tomorrow.
Her explanation is clear and reasonable.
This claim is still uncertain.
Safety is very important.
This is a popular Bengali song.
Dhaka is a famous city.
This task is urgent and necessary.
Regular practice is normal here.
This road is not safe at night.
The river is dangerous during a storm.
Fresh vegetables are very healthy.
This chemical substance is toxic.
The disease is serious but not contagious.
Today is my first workday.
This is our last chance.
The next meeting is next week.
This arrangement is not temporary; it is permanent.
The recent report is not final.
My school is very nearby.
That village is very distant.
We go to the local market.
The book is on the upper shelf.
This is a remote region.
This is my personal opinion.
The festival is a cultural event.
This is a scientific study.
The meeting is formal, but the discussion is public.
This information is personal and secret.
My bag is red.
The sky is dark blue today.

phrases.bn: বাগানে সাদা ও গোলাপি ফুল আছে।
phrases.pronunciation: bagane shada o golapi phul achhe
phrases.en: There are white and pink flowers in the garden.
The leaves are still green.
The window glass is completely transparent.

notes: Bengali adjectives generally do not change for gender or number.
